description: Land Acquisition - Compensations for the lands acquired in Weligampitiya & Ragama villages, Ja-ela D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices published under the Land Acquisition Act. It details specific land parcels being acquired by the state, including their names, lot numbers, extent, location, and compensation deposits. The content is focused solely on land and property-related matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
